user.title: Pair a tablet by address
user.description: Open the HA Sidecar app, choose Pair with Home Assistant, and enter the address and the code it shows. Normally the tablet is found automatically and you do not need this.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the tablet.
data_description.port: Shown on the tablet next to the address.
data_description.code: The code on the tablet. Leave empty to confirm on the tablet instead.

details.title: Add {name}
details.description:
Found at {host}. Choose how the tablet appears in Home Assistant.

The entity prefix makes every entity id `domain.prefix_entity`, for example `sensor.wallpanel_timers`, so several tablets never collide. It cannot be changed later.

data_description.name: The device name shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.entity_prefix: Lower-case letters, digits and single underscores, e.g. wallpanel.

verify.title: Confirm on the tablet

error.invalid_prefix: Use lower-case letters and digits, with single underscores between words, starting with a letter.
error.prefix_in_use: Another tablet already uses this prefix.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the tablet. Is pairing mode on, and are both on the same network?
error.not_pairing: The tablet is not in pairing mode.
error.no_session: The tablet lost the pairing session. Try again.
error.decrypt_failed: The secure exchange failed. Try again.

abort.already_configured: This tablet is already set up.
abort.not_ha_sidecar: That is not an HA Sidecar tablet.
abort.denied: The request was denied on the tablet.
abort.timeout: Nobody allowed the request on the tablet in time.
abort.no_session: The tablet lost the pairing session. Start again.
abort.decrypt_failed: The secure exchange failed. Start again.

enter_night_mode.name: Enter night mode
enter_night_mode.description: Switches the tablet to night brightness now, regardless of the Night starts / Night ends times, until exit_night_mode is called. Overrides a configured night entity. Applies while the Brightness mode is Auto.

device_id.name: Tablet
device_id.description: The tablet or tablets to send this to.

exit_night_mode.name: Exit night mode
exit_night_mode.description: Switches the tablet back to day brightness now, until enter_night_mode is called. Applies while the Brightness mode is Auto.

device_id.name: Tablet
device_id.description: The tablet or tablets to send this to.

follow_schedule.name: Follow schedule
follow_schedule.description: Instead of forcing day, hand control back to the Night starts / Night ends times.

restart_companion.name: Restart companion app
restart_companion.description: Closes and starts the Home Assistant companion app on the tablet again (device owner: hide and unhide; otherwise a relaunch).

device_id.name: Tablet
device_id.description: The tablet or tablets to send this to.

listen.name: Start listening
listen.description: Opens the assistant on the tablet and listens, as if the talk button was pressed (for a physical button or an automation). The tablet needs the microphone permission.

device_id.name: Tablet
device_id.description: The tablet or tablets to send this to.

cancel_listening.name: Cancel listening
cancel_listening.description: Ends the assistant turn that is running on the tablet and closes its screen.

device_id.name: Tablet
device_id.description: The tablet or tablets to send this to.

show_card.name: Show card
show_card.description: Shows a card on the tablet's voice screen: the weather, what is playing, a camera picture or any entity (give an entity), or one made by hand with a title, value and picture. During a conversation it is added to the answer; otherwise it appears on its own for a while. For an LLM, put this action in a script it can call as a tool.

device_id.name: Tablet
device_id.description: The tablet or tablets to send this to.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: A weather, media player, camera/image or any other entity to show.

type.name: Type
type.description: How a hand-made card looks (weather, media, image or entity).

value.name: Value
value.description: The big text, for example a temperature.

image.name: Image
image.description: A picture: a URL, or a path on Home Assistant such as /local/snapshot.jpg.

details.name: Details
details.description: Up to four short lines of small print.

duration.name: Show for
duration.description: How long a card without a conversation stays (seconds).

init.title: Display inputs and dashboard beacon
init.description: Entities that drive the tablet's brightness logic, and what to do when the dashboard beacon card stops pinging. Everything else is configured with the entities of the device.

data.beacon_heal: Restart the companion app when the beacon goes silent

data_description.presence_entities: Any of these being on means someone is near the tablet (mmWave, PIR, ...). Optional: the tablet can also use its camera.
data_description.night_entity: On = night. A sun entity counts as night while below the horizon. Leave empty to use the night schedule on the tablet.
data_description.glance_entities: Up to 9 entities whose values are shown on the at-a-glance screen (temperature, energy, ...).
data_description.beacon_heal: On by default. Only applies to tablets whose dashboard has an HA Sidecar beacon card, and only while the screen is on and the app is in front.
data_description.beacon_timeout: Minutes without a ping before the dashboard counts as unresponsive.
